title: Davis's papers for Marc Millis's propulsion physics program

tellings.quote: to do with UFOs. has to do with Mark propulsion physics program. I'm just contributing my knowledge.

plain: A physicist named Eric Davis, who has worked on Pentagon research, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that from the 1990s into the 2000s he wrote papers for a NASA research program on new ways to propel spacecraft, run by a man named Marc Millis. Davis says the work had nothing to do with UFOs: he was just contributing what he knew to Millis's propulsion physics program.
